description:
Everything we hold on what this property has sold and rented for: the
full sale history and the full rent history, each with its most recent
record called out separately.

This is the expensive one in the Property - History family, because it
returns complete series rather than a latest figure. For "what did it last
sell for", call `/history/sale/latest` instead.

**Price: 80¢ per call.**
